summary: Oncotelic Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary contributed its stake in Neurobridge IP Holdings Inc. to Lunai Bioworks, Inc. via a triangular merger. Oncotelic's subsidiary owned 62.5% of Holdings prior to the merger; consideration was 5 shares of Series B Convertible Preferred Stock of Lunai with a stated value of $12.5 million. The deal closed May 1, 2026. The filing lacks specific per-share price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor details. The transaction involves a patent portfolio with no operating business. Further disclosures may provide clarity on the nature of this acquisition.
